description: Dalaran Heist bosses A (phase 8 family 14): the first fifteen encounters of The Dalaran Heist (DALA_BOSS_01 to 15: Chomper, Awilo, The Great Akazamzarak, Kaye Toogie, The Amazing "Bonepaw", Dazzik "Hellscream", Flight Master Belnaara, Applebough, Archivist Oshi, Mo Eniwhiskers, Noz Timbertail, Cravitz Lorent, Albin Eastoft, Tierra Blythe, Moon Priestess Nici) and their boss-only cards (the four magical feats, "Scourgelord" Dazzik, Flying!, "Kind" Waitress). Boss deck lists are transcribed from hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages (read 2026-11-14), by card name; tools/dungeon-run-catalog (step 'encounters') resolves the names against facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json, checks every card and writes data/dungeon-run/encounters-v1.json. Level: the boss pages have no level table. A quantity list names its level in the page's note (level 6); a pool table's 'Total cards' column gives the deck sizes at the boss's levels, which grow with the level (10 at level 1, 15 at 2, 20 at 3, 25 at 4 and 5, 30 at 6: the notes of Whirt the All-Knowing, Albin Eastoft and Awilo), and the row takes the lowest level that holds the largest listed size; a hero printed with 10 Health is a level-1 boss. Tier: levels 1-2 tier 1, 3-4 tier 2, 5-6 tier 3 (the design's mapping); the fight's Health is the act curve's, not the printed 30 or 10.
method: Each page's wikitext (?action=raw) was read and its deck table transcribed by verify/tools/gen/p8f14/make_f14.py: rowspan- and colspan-aware, column by column in table order, Normal and Heroic separately. A 'Possible cards' pool lists each card once; a 'Quantity' table keeps its counts (each such list sums to 30). The wiki's disambiguated link names ('Shatter (card) (card)') are written as the card names; the boss-only cards carry their id.

adaptations.note: The wiki lists pools of possible cards (Normal and Heroic), not decks: the boss plays 10; 15 of them at its levels. A combat tier fights with 30: the Normal pool in table order, a second copy of each non-Legendary card, then the Heroic pool, then the curated fillers named in the row (the encounters step records each added card).

Reductomara's (1) less sits on every spell in both hands and decks as Reductomara'd (DALA_BOSS_03e); an Echo or 'Repeatable this turn' spell is never brought below (1). Bunnifitronus's critters are the wiki's three (Frog, Sheep, Squirrel). Presto Legendaro gives each player one random scripted collectible Legendary minion its side's generation filter allows (golden is a cosmetic the engine does not model).

Offered only after such a spell was played.

"Scourgelord" Dazzik (DALA_BOSS_06dk) is the boss card of the Heroic pool, a hero card like Scourgelord Garrosh: played, it replaces Dazzik's hero and power (Bladestorm, ICC_834h, the card's own hero power) and equips Shadowmourne; his Health and damage carry over and the card's 10 Armor is gained. The Normal pool and its second copies fill the 30 cards before the Heroic pool is reached, so one copy is shuffled into his deck after the mulligan (the row's start block), as family 10 does for Grubb's Chuck. The inventory's note (a phased Dazzik) does not match the wiki, which lists the card as a deck card: it is not a form of the row.
The wiki lists the level-6 deck with its quantities (30 cards, Normal and Heroic): the Normal list is the deck; an unusable card is replaced as recorded.
The page's note: the deck is the level-6 deck of Chapter 5 (levels 4-5: five cards fewer). Level 6: tier 3.

Avian Watcher (KAR_037, "Battlecry: If you control a Secret, gain +1/+1 and Taunt") is not admitted in a boss deck (its Secret condition has no boss row); a second copy of a single of the list takes its place.

Take Flight! counts the damage her hero takes (Health lost; Armor absorbs) down from 15 on the power; at 0 she takes flight: her power becomes Flying! (form 1, a script form: the hero, its Health and Armor stay) and her hero is Immune (Flying!, DALA_BOSS_07e). Flying! counts 2 down at the start of each of her turns; at 0 she lands: Immune ends and Take Flight! returns with a fresh count (form 0). The client text leaves the turn count open: her own turns.

Blessing of Elune doubles all healing of both players (the ALL_HEALING_DOUBLE controller aura Crystalsmith Kangor uses; with Auchenai Soulpriest or Bwonsamdi's Covenant the converted damage is the doubled amount, as Prophet Velen's doubling). The page's note on the AI (it avoids the player's hero after converting healing to damage) is the original AI's, not a rule.
